     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteGaloisQuotientAffine
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Γ-stable affine covers from the orbit-in-affine hypothesis (campaign `G2(a)`)
    10	
    11	Let `L/K` be a finite Galois extension with group `Γ = Gal(L/K)` and let `X` be a
    12	scheme over `Spec L` with a semilinear `Γ`-action `ρ` (`SemilinearGalAction`).  This
    13	file discharges the gate `HasStableAffineCover` (the EGA II 4.5.4 pattern) from the
    14	orbit-in-affine hypothesis `ρ.OrbitsInAffineOpen`: **every point of `X` has a
    15	`Γ`-stable affine open neighbourhood** (`hasStableAffineCover_of_orbitsInAffineOpen`,
    16	registered as the sanctioned instance).  This is the geometric step `G2(a)` feeding
    17	the quotient gluing `G2(c)`; the deep gate `HasGaloisQuotient` is instance-free only for
    18	a **non-affine** total space — `Picard/GaloisQuotientAffineGeneral.lean` discharges it
    19	globally under `[IsAffine X]`.
    20	
    21	## Pinned route (recorded before proving, per the campaign plan)
    22	
    23	Fix `x : X` with orbit inside the affine open `U` (the hypothesis; the orbit is
    24	finite because `Γ` is finite for finite-dimensional `L/K`).  Pin the **ambient open**
    25	`W := ⋂_γ (act γ)⁻¹ U` — a `Γ`-stable open (not necessarily affine) containing the
    26	orbit and contained in `U` (the `γ = 1` factor).
    27	
    28	1. **Prime avoidance** (`exists_mem_basicOpen_le_of_finite`, then transported into
    29	   the scheme by `IsAffineOpen.fromSpec` bookkeeping in
    30	   `exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite`): there is `s ∈ Γ(X, U)` with
    31	   `orbit ⊆ D(s) ⊆ W`.  The algebraic heart is `Ideal.subset_union_prime`: the
    32	   vanishing ideal of `X \ W` in `Γ(X, U)` is not contained in the union of the
    33	   finitely many primes of the orbit points.
    34	2. **The norm** `N := ∏_γ γ(s)|_W ∈ Γ(X, W)`, where `γ(s) := (act γ).app U s` is the
    35	   section transport `Γ(X, U) → Γ(X, (act γ)⁻¹ U)`.  Then
    36	   `D(N) = ⋂_γ (act γ)⁻¹ D(s)`, by `D(product) = ⋂ D(factor)` and
    37	   `Scheme.preimage_basicOpen`.
    38	3. **Wall bypass (audit)**: `Γ`-stability of `D(N)` is proved at the level of
    39	   *opens*, never of sections: `(act τ)⁻¹ D(N) = ⋂_γ (act τ)⁻¹ (act γ)⁻¹ D(s)
    40	   = ⋂_γ (act (γτ))⁻¹ D(s) = D(N)` by preimage functoriality and reindexing the
    41	   finite intersection along `γ ↦ γτ⁻¹`.  No `γ`-twisted section identities (the
    42	   "norm is `Γ`-invariant" wall named in the gate docstring) are needed; the only
    43	   section transport used is `Scheme.preimage_basicOpen`.  In particular no
    44	   separatedness is assumed anywhere.
    45	4. **Affineness**: `D(N) ⊆ D(s)` (the `γ = 1` factor), so `D(N) = D(N|_{D(s)})`
    46	   is a basic open of the affine `D(s)` (`Scheme.basicOpen_res` +
    47	   `IsAffineOpen.basicOpen`), hence affine.  This is why no affineness of `W` (nor
    48	   of intersections of affines) is ever required.
    49	5. **Membership**: `x ∈ (act γ)⁻¹ D(s)` for every `γ` is exactly the prime-avoidance
    50	   conclusion `orbit ⊆ D(s)`.
    51	
    52	## Main results
    53	
    54	* `exists_mem_basicOpen_le_of_finite` — finite prime avoidance in `Spec R`: finitely
    55	  many points of an open `W` lie in a basic open contained in `W`.
    56	* `exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite` — the scheme form, for finitely many points of an
    57	  affine open `U` (reusable infrastructure; the one-point case is mathlib's
    58	  `IsAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le`).
    59	* `SemilinearGalAction.exists_stable_affineOpen_of_orbitsInAffineOpen` — every point
    60	  has a `Γ`-stable affine open neighbourhood.
    61	* `hasStableAffineCover_of_orbitsInAffineOpen` — the gate `HasStableAffineCover`
    62	  holds under `[FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [ρ.OrbitsInAffineOpen]`
    63	  (instance; this is the sanctioned discharge of this gate and of no other).
    64	
    65	Campaign reference: `G2(a)` of `informal/pic-representability-campaign.md`.  Sources:
    66	EGA II 4.5.4 for the refinement pattern; SGA I V.1 and Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*
    67	§7 use the same norm trick for quotients by finite groups.
    68	-/
    69	
    70	universe u
    71	
    72	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace
    73	
    74	namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
    75	
    76	/-! ## Finite-intersection and finite-product bookkeeping -/
    77	
    78	/-- Membership in a finite infimum of opens is membership in every member.  (The
    79	infinite `iInf` version is false — `iInf` of opens takes an interior — which is why
    80	the `Γ`-stable hull below is a `Finset.inf`.) -/
    81	lemma mem_finset_inf {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι}
    82	    {F : ι → Opens α} {x : α} :
    83	    x ∈ s.inf F ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, x ∈ F i := by
    84	  classical
    85	  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
    86	  | empty => simp
    87	  | cons a t ha ih => simp [Opens.mem_inf, ih]
    88	
    89	/-- The preimage of a finite infimum of opens under a morphism of schemes is the
    90	finite infimum of the preimages. -/
    91	lemma preimage_finset_inf {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    92	    (F : ι → Y.Opens) :
    93	    h ⁻¹ᵁ s.inf F = s.inf fun i => h ⁻¹ᵁ F i := by
    94	  classical
    95	  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
    96	  | empty => simp
    97	  | cons a t ha ih => rw [Finset.inf_cons, Finset.inf_cons, h.preimage_inf, ih]
    98	
    99	/-- The basic open of a finite product of sections is the finite infimum of the
   100	basic opens of the factors (nonempty index set; the empty product would need the
   101	ambient open on the right). -/
   102	lemma basicOpen_finset_prod {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens} {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι}
   103	    (hs : s.Nonempty) (g : ι → Γ(X, V)) :
   104	    X.basicOpen (∏ i ∈ s, g i) = s.inf fun i => X.basicOpen (g i) := by
   105	  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
   106	  | singleton a => simp
   107	  | cons a t ha ht ih => rw [Finset.prod_cons, Scheme.basicOpen_mul, ih, Finset.inf_cons]
   108	
   109	/-! ## Finite prime avoidance -/
   110	
   111	/-- **Finite prime avoidance in `Spec R`**: finitely many points of an open
   112	`W ⊆ Spec R` lie in a common basic open `D(f) ⊆ W`.  Writing `X \ W = V(I)`, each
   113	point is a prime not containing `I`; by prime avoidance (`Ideal.subset_union_prime`)
   114	`I` is not contained in the union of these primes, and any `f ∈ I` avoiding all of
   115	them works. -/
   116	theorem exists_mem_basicOpen_le_of_finite {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
   117	    (W : Opens (PrimeSpectrum R)) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
   118	    (p : ι → PrimeSpectrum R) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ W) :
   119	    ∃ f : R, (∀ i, p i ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) ∧ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ W := by
   120	  classical
   121	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (PrimeSpectrum.isOpen_iff (W : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))).mp W.2
   122	  have hWc : (W : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) = (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus c)ᶜ := by
   123	    rw [← hc, compl_compl]
   124	  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
   125	  | inl h =>
   126	    refine ⟨0, fun i => (h.false i).elim, ?_⟩
   127	    rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_zero]
   128	    exact bot_le
   129	  | inr h =>
   130	    cases nonempty_fintype ι
   131	    have hnle : ∀ i, ¬Ideal.span c ≤ (p i).asIdeal := by
   132	      intro i hle
   133	      have hpi : p i ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus c)ᶜ := by
   134	        rw [← hWc]; exact hp i
   135	      exact hpi ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus _ _).mpr (Ideal.span_le.mp hle))
   136	    obtain ⟨f, hfc, hf⟩ : ∃ f ∈ Ideal.span c, ∀ i, f ∉ (p i).asIdeal := by
   137	      by_contra habs
   138	      push Not at habs
   139	      have hsub : (Ideal.span c : Set R) ⊆
   140	          ⋃ i ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset ι) : Set ι), ((p i).asIdeal : Set R) := by
   141	        intro f hf
   142	        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := habs f hf
   143	        exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_univ i)) hi
   144	      obtain ⟨i, -, hle⟩ := (Ideal.subset_union_prime h.some h.some
   145	        fun i _ _ _ => (p i).isPrime).mp hsub
   146	      exact hnle i hle
   147	    refine ⟨f, fun i => (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen f (p i)).mpr (hf i), fun q hq => ?_⟩
   148	    have hq' : f ∉ q.asIdeal := (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen f q).mp hq
   149	    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, hWc]
   150	    intro hzl
   151	    exact hq' (Ideal.span_le.mpr ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus _ _).mp hzl) hfc)
   152	
   153	/-- **Finite prime avoidance in an affine open of a scheme** (reusable
   154	infrastructure; the one-point case is mathlib's `IsAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le`):
   155	finitely many points of an open `V` all lying in an affine open `U` lie in a common
   156	basic open `D(s) ⊆ V` of a section `s ∈ Γ(X, U)`.  Proved by transporting
   157	`exists_mem_basicOpen_le_of_finite` along `hU.fromSpec`. -/
   158	theorem exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens}
   159	    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
   160	    (y : ι → X) (hyU : ∀ i, y i ∈ U) (hyV : ∀ i, y i ∈ V) :
   161	    ∃ s : Γ(X, U), (∀ i, y i ∈ X.basicOpen s) ∧ X.basicOpen s ≤ V := by
   162	  obtain ⟨s, hmem, hle⟩ := exists_mem_basicOpen_le_of_finite (hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   163	    (fun i => hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y i, hyU i⟩)
   164	    (fun i => by
   165	      change hU.fromSpec (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y i, hyU i⟩) ∈ V
   166	      rw [hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf]
   167	      exact hyV i)
   168	  refine ⟨s, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
   169	  · have h := hmem i
   170	    rw [← hU.fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen] at h
   171	    have h2 : hU.fromSpec (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y i, hyU i⟩) ∈ X.basicOpen s := h
   172	    rwa [hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] at h2
   173	  · rw [← hU.fromSpec_image_basicOpen]
   174	    exact (hU.fromSpec.image_mono hle).trans (hU.fromSpec.image_preimage_le V)
   175	
   176	/-! ## The Γ-stable affine neighbourhood -/
   177	
   178	namespace SemilinearGalAction
   179	
   180	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
   181	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
   182	
   183	lemma act_one_hom (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) : (ρ.act 1).hom = 𝟙 X := by
   184	  rw [map_one]; rfl
   185	
   186	lemma act_mul_hom (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) (γ τ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
   187	    (ρ.act (γ * τ)).hom = (ρ.act τ).hom ≫ (ρ.act γ).hom := by
   188	  rw [map_mul]; rfl
   189	
   190	/-- **The `Γ`-stable affine neighbourhood theorem** (campaign `G2(a)`, EGA II 4.5.4
   191	pattern): under the orbit-in-affine hypothesis, every point of `X` has a `Γ`-stable
   192	affine open neighbourhood — the content of the gate `HasStableAffineCover`.  See the
   193	module docstring for the pinned route (prime avoidance + norm, with `Γ`-stability
   194	proved at the level of opens by reindexing, bypassing the section-transport wall). -/
   195	theorem exists_stable_affineOpen_of_orbitsInAffineOpen [FiniteDimensional K L]
   196	    (ρ : SemilinearGalAction K L X f) [ρ.OrbitsInAffineOpen] (x : X) :
   197	    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ ρ.IsStableOpen U := by
   198	  classical
   199	  obtain ⟨U, hxU⟩ := OrbitsInAffineOpen.exists_affineOpen (ρ := ρ) x
   200	  -- the whole orbit of `x` meets every translated chart:
   201	  -- `act γ (act τ x) = act (γ * τ) x ∈ U`.
   202	  have horb : ∀ τ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (ρ.act γ).hom.base ((ρ.act τ).hom.base x) ∈ U.1 := by
   203	    intro τ γ
   204	    have h : (ρ.act γ).hom.base ((ρ.act τ).hom.base x) = (ρ.act (γ * τ)).hom.base x := by
   205	      rw [ρ.act_mul_hom γ τ]; rfl
   206	    rw [h]; exact hxU (γ * τ)
   207	  -- prime avoidance: `orbit ⊆ D(s) ⊆ W := ⋂_γ (act γ)⁻¹ U`.
   208	  obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_le⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite U.2
   209	    (fun γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (ρ.act γ).hom.base x) hxU
   210	    (V := Finset.univ.inf fun γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (ρ.act γ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
   211	    (fun τ => mem_finset_inf.mpr fun γ _ => horb τ γ)
   212	  -- `W ≤ (act γ)⁻¹ U` for every `γ`, so the transported sections restrict to `W`.
   213	  have hWle : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
   214	      (Finset.univ.inf fun δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (ρ.act δ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≤
   215	        (ρ.act γ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 :=
   216	    fun γ => Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ γ)
   217	  -- the norm `N = ∏_γ γ(s)|_W` and its factors
   218	  set t : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) → Γ(X, Finset.univ.inf fun δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (ρ.act δ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :=
   219	    fun γ => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWle γ)).op ((ρ.act γ).hom.app U.1 s) with ht
   220	  set N : Γ(X, Finset.univ.inf fun δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (ρ.act δ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :=
   221	    ∏ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, t γ with hN
   222	  -- each factor cuts out the corresponding translate of `D(s)` inside `W`
   223	  have hbo_t : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
   224	      X.basicOpen (t γ) =
   225	        (Finset.univ.inf fun δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (ρ.act δ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⊓
   226	          (ρ.act γ).hom ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s := by
   227	    intro γ
   228	    rw [ht, Scheme.basicOpen_res, ← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen]
   229	  -- the `γ = 1` translate is `D(s)` itself
   230	  have hP1 : (ρ.act (1 : L ≃ₐ[K] L)).hom ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen s = X.basicOpen s := by
   231	    rw [ρ.act_one_hom]; rfl
   232	  -- `D(N) = ⋂_γ (act γ)⁻¹ D(s)`
